name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Senior Customer Success Manager | Mid-Market Portfolio Ownership, Retention & Expansion, AI-Enabled Execution
summary: Customer success and account management professional with 15+ years in B2B SaaS, owning portfolios from onboarding through retention and expansion. At Birdeye I used utilization signals to flag at-risk partners early and retained all but one of 15-20 (~94%). At Wix I carried up to ~25 concurrent accounts, launched 25+ per month at 110% of implementation targets, and drove a 25% conversion improvement across supported accounts. AI is part of how I work every day: I direct LLMs for research and drafting, build AI-enabled workflows with LLM APIs, and score AI output against rubrics before anything reaches a client.

Translate loosely defined business goals into precise prompts and agent instructions, and grade AI output against rubric-based criteria so quality holds before it reaches a client.
Build dashboards and report on a regular cadence, tying adoption to outcomes and turning the data into specific recommendations for leadership.
Identify expansion opportunities with existing clients, recommending and scoping complementary services aligned with their goals.
Design automated onboarding and lifecycle workflows that activate, nurture, and retain customers at scale.
